title: Gengar Can Cool a Room by Nearly 10 Degrees

direction.premise: When Gengar hides nearby, it steals surrounding heat and can cool the area by nearly ten degrees Fahrenheit.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Gengar's hidden presence turns a sudden chill into a frightening warning.
direction.openLoop: What causes the chill, and how far can the temperature fall?
direction.payoff: The chill is the warning: hidden Gengar can cool the area by nearly ten degrees Fahrenheit.
direction.engagementQuestion: Would you hide, or investigate the sudden chill?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and uneasy. Stress hidden, steals, sudden chill, and nearly ten degrees. Pause briefly before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: HIDDEN. NEARLY TEN DEGREES.
scenes.narration: Gengar hides nearby. The room drops nearly ten degrees.
scenes.caption: A HIDDEN GENGAR CHANGES THE TEMPERATURE

scenes.headline: THE CHILL GIVES IT AWAY
scenes.narration: Gengar steals surrounding heat, so a sudden chill gives it away.
scenes.caption: SUDDEN CHILL? GENGAR MAY BE CLOSE.

scenes.headline: THE SHADOW HIDES THE CAUSE
scenes.narration: It hides in shadows. The temperature drops before you see it.
scenes.caption: THE COLD ARRIVES FIRST

scenes.headline: NEARLY TEN DEGREES COLDER
scenes.narration: Hiding Gengar can cool the area nearly ten degrees Fahrenheit.
scenes.caption: NEARLY 10°F COOLER

scenes.headline: GENGAR TAKES THE HEAT
scenes.narration: That chill has a cause: Gengar takes heat from the room.
scenes.caption: THE COLD MEANS HEAT IS MISSING

scenes.headline: HIDE OR INVESTIGATE?
scenes.narration: Would you hide, or investigate the sudden chill?
scenes.caption: HIDE OR INVESTIGATE?
